From brief
to action.

Explore a practical framework for each area of focus.

Understand

Find the foundation.

Understand the audience, the brand’s purpose, and the value it brings.

Define

Make it distinctive.

Shape a clear position and a consistent message that reflects the brand.

Refine

Listen and evolve.

Review audience response and brand perception to identify the next improvement.

Identify

Find the right fit.

Define the ideal customer and research prospects with a relevant business need.

Qualify

Prioritise relevance.

Assess interest, fit, and readiness so attention goes to meaningful opportunities.

Connect

Start a conversation.

Keep the next step clear, organise follow-up, and track progress toward an opportunity.

Listen

Know the audience.

Understand the audience’s needs and define a clear communication objective.

Plan

Give the message purpose.

Connect the brand’s value to a relevant message and a considered campaign plan.

Learn

Review the response.

Look at audience engagement and feedback to guide the next iteration.

Align

Choose the right voices.

Consider creator relevance, audience fit and alignment with the brand’s values.

Collaborate

Build a clear brief.

Set the message, deliverables and expectations while leaving room for the creator’s own voice.

Review

Keep the brand consistent.

Review content, coordination and audience response against the collaboration’s purpose.

What can you do for my brand?+

I bring a 360-degree marketing perspective, from brand strategy and digital presence to campaigns, lead generation, follow-ups and customer conversion. The focus is on connecting the work across the customer journey.

Can you coordinate both marketing and operations?+

Yes. My experience includes working with agencies, clinic and corporate teams, founders, vendors, medical representatives, celebrities and models, supporting campaigns, shoots, events and day-to-day coordination.

Which brands and industries have you worked across?+

My experience includes Naturals, Zenderma, HairToppings, Red Bull and Graxi Tech. The work spans beauty and wellness, healthcare, education and EdTech, real estate, elevators and creative businesses.

What was your role with Red Bull?+

Web Media Analyst in the Media Intelligence Team, analysing articles, brand mentions and campaign coverage, validating content and supporting accurate reporting and audience insights.

How do we start a conversation?+

Email Katherin at katherinbast97@gmail.com with a little about your brand, its current priorities and the support you’re looking for.
